A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed and constructed a new type of detector, which is able to provide the necessary accuracy for the measurements of extensive air showers.

this detector is a new type of scintonic device, with the following features: 1) the uniformity of the detector; 2) the high dynamic range; 3) the high time resolution; 4) the high efficiency; 5) the low price.
